flags.why: Đỡ đầu describes the godparent role in cha đỡ đầu or mẹ đỡ đầu; it does not itself mean the person 'godparent' ([dictionary](https://dilib.vn/img/pdf/6762-tu-dien-tieng-viet-thuviensach.vn.pdf)).
flags.fix: acting as a godparent (in cha đỡ đầu, godfather, and mẹ đỡ đầu, godmother)

flags.why: The general meaning of sponsoring and looking after someone is more commonly encountered than the specifically religious meaning.
The example explains the word's meaning instead of using it.
flags.fix: Trên tranh, đôi gà thư hùng đứng cạnh nhau. = In the painting, the male and female chickens stand side by side.

flags.why: Hoắc is an everyday colloquial intensifier in expressions such as lạ hoắc and thối hoắc, so rare is misleading.
Gai hoa hồng xước vào tay tôi is unnatural because the thorns cause the scratch rather than perform an action expressed as xước vào.
flags.fix: Gai hoa hồng làm xước tay tôi. = The rose thorns scratched my hand.
